text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 50, "unit": "birds", "kind": "count", "span": "a total of 50 birds"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 120, "unit": "birds", "kind": "count", "span": "he saw 120 birds"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 20, "unit": "birds", "kind": "count", "span": "day six he saw 20"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 90, "unit": "birds", "kind": "count", "span": "day seven he saw 90"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 7, "unit": "days", "kind": "count", "span": "day seven (7 days over the week)"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "days 1-5 birds = 50 + 120 = 170 (day 3 contributed none)"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "+ day six = 190"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "+ day seven = 280 total birds for the week"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s3", "q5"], "out": "s4", "note": "average per day = 280 / 7 = 40"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "average number of birds Mack saw per day over the week"}, "dismissed": []}
